name: page_stack_get

provenance.source: Exact .155 AP-backed IDA function and app_list_get_page callee at 0x0c697318; raw function chunk independently rehashed against the pinned AP.

notes: Returns zero if the global page stack at 0x200c33ac is absent; otherwise delegates to app_list_get_page. Its callee adds the page count to negative indices, so -1 selects the top page. Borrowed pointer; UI owner thread only, never under interrupt lock. Device probe pending.
